body:
An AI agent produced a Lean proof of `PierceBirkhoff.pierce_birkhoff_conjecture` as stated for
about **$11.71** of API spend, which is unrealistically low for a research-open conjecture from
the Wikipedia set.

AI review of the accepted proof suggests the statement is misformalized, in the following way (AI-written):

> The defect is in the file's notion of semialgebraic set:
>
> ```lean
> def IsSemiAlgebraic {n : ℕ} (S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) : Prop :=
>   ∃ (ι₀ ι₁ : Type) (p₀ : ι₀ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (p₁ : ι₁ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ),
>     Finite ι₀ ∧ Finite ι₁ ∧
>     S = (⋃ i, {x | MvPolynomial.eval x (p₀ i) = 0}) ∪ ⋃ i, {x | MvPolynomial.eval x (p₁ i) > 0}
> ```
>
> This allows only a **union** of single-polynomial zero sets and single-polynomial strict
> positivity sets, with no intersections and no boolean combinations, although the docstring itself
> describes semialgebraic sets as "a finite union of sets defined by multivariate polynomial
> equations and inequalities" (plural, i.e. basic sets `{p = 0, q₁ > 0, …, qₖ > 0}`). The class
> defined here is strictly smaller. Concretely, the closed quadrant
> `{x | x 0 ≥ 0} ∩ {x | x 1 ≥ 0}` in ℝ² is provably **not** of this form: any point of the
> boundary rays cannot lie in an open piece `{p₁ i > 0}` (an open subset of the set consists of
> interior points), so the two rays must be covered by finitely many zero sets `{p₀ i = 0}` that
> are contained in the quadrant; but a polynomial vanishing on infinitely many points of a line
> vanishes on the whole line, and neither axis lies inside the quadrant.
>
> Consequently `IsPiecewiseMvPolynomial` ("a finite covering of ℝⁿ by closed semialgebraic sets
> such that the restriction of `f` to each set is polynomial") quantifies over far fewer
> coverings than the Pierce–Birkhoff hypothesis, excluding exactly the orthant-style pieces that
> make the real conjecture hard. The theorem proved is a genuine but much weaker statement, and
> the accepted proof visibly relies on the special shape: it splits each covering set into its
> algebraic part and its principal-open part (`rcases … with hi | hi` after rewriting with the
> union decomposition), handles the principal opens off a null hypersurface, and glues by
> continuity.
>
> A smaller wart in the conclusion: `⨆ i, ⨅ j` over `Finite` index *types* uses ℝ's junk value
> `sSup ∅ = 0` when an index type is empty; nonempty finite index types (or `Finset`-indexed
> `sup'/inf'`) would be more faithful to "f = supᵢ infⱼ gᵢⱼ".
>
> Suggested fix: define `IsSemiAlgebraic` as closure under finite unions of **basic**
> semialgebraic sets (finite intersections of `{p = 0}` / `{p > 0}`), or equivalently as the
> boolean algebra generated by sets `{x | 0 < eval x p}`.

<details>
<summary>The accepted Lean proof</summary>

```lean
import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Pierce–Birkhoff conjecture

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pierce%E2%80%93Birkhoff_conjecture)

The Pierce-Birkhoff conjecture asserts that any piecewise-polynomial function can be expressed
as a maximum of finite minima of finite collections of polynomials. It was first stated in 1956
by Garrett Birkhoff and Richard S. Pierce, though the modern rigorous formulation is due to
Melvin Henriksen and John R. Isbell.

The conjecture has been proved for `n = 1` and `n = 2` by Louis Mahé.
-/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

/--
A set is semi-algebraic in `ℝⁿ` if it can be described by a finite union of sets defined by
multivariate polynomial equations and inequalities.
-/
def IsSemiAlgebraic {n : ℕ} (S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι₀ ι₁ : Type) (p₀ : ι₀ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (p₁ : ι₁ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ),
    Finite ι₀ ∧ Finite ι₁ ∧
    S = (⋃ i, {x | MvPolynomial.eval x (p₀ i) = 0}) ∪ ⋃ i, {x | MvPolynomial.eval x (p₁ i) > 0}

/--
A set is semi-algebraic in `ℝ` if it can be described by a finite boolean combination
of polynomial equations and inequalities.
-/
def IsSemiAlgebraic₁ (S : Set ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι₀ ι₁ : Type) (p₀ : ι₀ → Polynomial ℝ) (p₁ : ι₁ → Polynomial ℝ), Finite ι₀ ∧ Finite ι₁ ∧
    S = (⋃ i, {x | Polynomial.eval x (p₀ i) = 0}) ∪ ⋃ i, {x | Polynomial.eval x (p₁ i) > 0}

open scoped Polynomial

/--
A function `f : ℝⁿ → ℝ` is piecewise polynomial if there exists a finite covering of `ℝⁿ` by
closed semi-algebraic sets such that the restriction of `f` to each set in the covering is
polynomial.
-/
def IsPiecewiseMvPolynomial {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι : Type) (P : ι → Set (Fin n → ℝ))
    (g : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ),
    Finite ι ∧
    (∀ i, IsClosed (P i)) ∧
    (∀ i, IsSemiAlgebraic (P i)) ∧
    (⋃ i, P i) = Set.univ ∧
    ∀ᵉ (i : ι) (x ∈ P i), f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g i)

/--
A function `f : ℝ → ℝ` is piecewise polynomial if there exists a finite covering of `ℝ` by
closed semi-algebraic sets such that the restriction of `f` to each set in the covering is
polynomial.
-/
def IsPiecewisePolynomial (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι : Type) (P : ι → Set ℝ)
    (g : ι → Polynomial ℝ),
    Finite ι ∧
    (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (P i)) ∧
    (∀ (i : ι), IsSemiAlgebraic₁ (P i)) ∧
    (⋃ (i : ι), P i) = Set.univ ∧
    ∀ᵉ (i : ι) (x ∈ P i), f x = Polynomial.eval x (g i)

end PierceBirkhoff

/-!
## Proof for the stated definition of semialgebraic pieces

Here `IsSemiAlgebraic` permits finite unions of individual zero sets and strict
positivity sets. The proof uses this atomic form. Factor the defining polynomials
and all differences of the finitely many polynomial labels. On a generic
coordinate fiber, their squarefree product has only simple roots. At such a root,
the sign changes of the atoms control the change of label. A sign invariant then
proves that two labels are connected by factors whose signs differ at the two
points. This gives a fixed finite family of two-point polynomial separators.
Continuity and finite lattice interpolation yield the required supremum of infima.
-/

/-! Finite lattice interpolation from two-point polynomial separators. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

lemma finite_separators_sup_inf {X ι : Type} [Nonempty X] [Finite ι]
    (p : ι → X → ℝ) (f : X → ℝ)
    (hsep : ∀ x y, ∃ i, f x ≤ p i x ∧ p i y ≤ f y) :
    ∃ (α β : Type) (g : α → β → ι), Finite α ∧ Finite β ∧
      ∀ x, f x = ⨆ a, ⨅ b, p (g a b) x := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let S (x : X) : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f x ≤ p i x)
  have hSne (x : X) : (S x).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, _⟩ := hsep x x
    exact ⟨i, by simp [S, hi]⟩
  have hScover (x y : X) : ∃ i ∈ S x, p i y ≤ f y := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hj⟩ := hsep x y
    exact ⟨i, by simp [S, hi], hj⟩
  let α := {s : Finset ι // s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ y, ∃ i ∈ s, p i y ≤ f y}
  let A (x : X) : α := ⟨S x, hSne x, hScover x⟩
  letI : Nonempty α := ⟨A (Classical.arbitrary X)⟩
  letI : Nonempty ι := (hSne (Classical.arbitrary X)).to_subtype.map Subtype.val
  let g (a : α) (i : ι) : ι := if i ∈ a.val then i else a.property.1.choose
  have hg_mem (a : α) (i : ι) : g a i ∈ a.val := by
    simp only [g]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact hi
    · exact a.property.1.choose_spec
  refine ⟨α, ι, g, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun x => le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · apply le_trans _ (le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range _) (A x))
    apply le_ciInf
    intro i
    have := hg_mem (A x) i
    simpa only [A, S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using this
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro a
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hif⟩ := a.property.2 x
    apply (ciInf_le (Finite.bddBelow_range _) i).trans
    simpa only [g, if_pos hi] using hif

lemma finite_polynomial_separators {n : ℕ} {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (p : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hsep : ∀ x y, ∃ i, f x ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (p i) ∧
      MvPolynomial.eval y (p i) ≤ f y) :
    ∃ (α β : Type) (g : α → β → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ),
      Finite α ∧ Finite β ∧
      ∀ x, f x = ⨆ a, ⨅ b, MvPolynomial.eval x (g a b) := by
  obtain ⟨α, β, g, hα, hβ, hg⟩ :=
    finite_separators_sup_inf (fun i x => MvPolynomial.eval x (p i)) f hsep
  exact ⟨α, β, fun a b => p (g a b), hα, hβ, hg⟩

lemma finite_separators_of_dense {X ι : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [Finite ι]
    (p : ι → X → ℝ) (f : X → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, Continuous (p i))
    (hf : Continuous f) {S : Set (X × X)} (hS : Dense S)
    (hsep : ∀ z ∈ S, ∃ i, f z.1 ≤ p i z.1 ∧ p i z.2 ≤ f z.2) :
    ∀ x y, ∃ i, f x ≤ p i x ∧ p i y ≤ f y := by
  let T (i : ι) : Set (X × X) :=
    {z | f z.1 ≤ p i z.1 ∧ p i z.2 ≤ f z.2}
  have hclosed (i : ι) : IsClosed (T i) :=
    (isClosed_le (hf.comp continuous_fst) ((hp i).comp continuous_fst)).inter
      (isClosed_le ((hp i).comp continuous_snd) (hf.comp continuous_snd))
  have hsub : S ⊆ ⋃ i, T i := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsep z hz
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hall : (⋃ i, T i) = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
    intro z
    have hz := closure_mono hsub (hS z)
    rwa [(isClosed_iUnion_of_finite hclosed).closure_eq] at hz
  intro x y
  have : (x, y) ∈ ⋃ i, T i := by rw [hall]; trivial
  simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion, T, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using this

end PierceBirkhoff

/-! Algebraic and topological genericity lemmas for polynomial selections. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

open Polynomial
open scoped nonZeroDivisors


lemma map_associated_primPart {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (p : R[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Associated (p.map (algebraMap R K)) (p.primPart.map (algebraMap R K)) := by
  have hc : IsUnit (C (algebraMap R K p.content)) := by
    apply isUnit_C.mpr
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro h
    apply hp
    exact content_eq_zero_iff.mp ((IsFractionRing.injective R K) (by simpa using h))
  conv_lhs => rw [p.eq_C_content_mul_primPart]
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, mul_comm]
  exact associated_mul_unit_left _ _ hc

lemma integer_primPart_associated {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (p : K[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Associated ((IsLocalization.integerNormalization R⁰ p).primPart.map (algebraMap R K)) p := by
  have hn : IsLocalization.integerNormalization R⁰ p ≠ 0 :=
    mt IsFractionRing.integerNormalization_eq_zero_iff.mp hp
  apply (map_associated_primPart _ hn).symm.trans
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsLocalization.integerNormalization_map_to_map R⁰ p
  rw [hb, Algebra.smul_def, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply, mul_comm]
  apply associated_mul_unit_left
  apply isUnit_C.mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  simpa only [map_zero] using (IsFractionRing.injective R K).ne
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp b.property)

lemma squarefree_map_fraction {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    {p : R[X]} (hp : Squarefree p) : Squarefree (p.map (algebraMap R K)) := by
  intro q hq
  have hm : p.map (algebraMap R K) ≠ 0 :=
    mt (Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff (IsFractionRing.injective R K)).mp hp.ne_zero
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst q
    simpa using (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hm hq)
  let q' := (IsLocalization.integerNormalization R⁰ q).primPart
  have hq' : q'.IsPrimitive := Polynomial.isPrimitive_primPart _
  have ha : Associated (q'.map (algebraMap R K)) q := integer_primPart_associated q hq0
  have hdiv : q' * q' ∣ p.primPart := by
    apply (hq'.mul hq').dvd_of_fraction_map_dvd_fraction_map (K := K) p.isPrimitive_primPart
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul]
    apply (ha.mul_mul ha).dvd_iff_dvd_left.mpr
    exact (map_associated_primPart p hp.ne_zero).dvd_iff_dvd_right.mp hq
  have hunit : IsUnit q' := hp q' (hdiv.trans p.primPart_dvd)
  exact ha.isUnit_iff.mp (hunit.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap R K)))



lemma mvPolynomial_eq_zero_of_ball {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ]
    (p : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (x : σ → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x ε, MvPolynomial.eval y p = 0) : p = 0 := by
  apply MvPolynomial.funext_set (fun i => Set.Ioo (x i - ε) (x i + ε))
    (fun i => Set.Ioo_infinite (by linarith))
  intro y hy
  rw [map_zero]
  apply h y
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_pi_lt_iff hε]
  intro i
  have hi := hy i (Set.mem_univ i)
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith [hi.1, hi.2]

lemma mvPolynomial_nonzero_dense {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ]
    {p : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Dense {x : σ → ℝ | MvPolynomial.eval x p ≠ 0} := by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro x ε hε
  by_contra h
  apply hp
  apply mvPolynomial_eq_zero_of_ball p x hε
  intro y hy
  by_contra hn
  exact h ⟨y, hy, hn⟩

lemma generic_polynomial_specialization {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [NormalizedGCDMonoid A] [CharZero A] {p : A[X]} (hp : Squarefree p) :
    ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (φ : A →+* ℝ), φ d ≠ 0 → (p.map φ).Separable := by
  by_cases hd : p.natDegree = 0
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero.mp hd
    refine ⟨c, ?_, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
    · simpa using hp.ne_zero
    · simpa only [Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.separable_C, isUnit_iff_ne_zero] using hφ
  let K := FractionRing A
  let φ : A →+* K := algebraMap A K
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := IsFractionRing.injective A K
  have hsep : (p.map φ).Separable :=
    PerfectField.separable_iff_squarefree.mpr (squarefree_map_fraction hp)
  let d := p.resultant p.derivative
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' := Polynomial.resultant_ne_zero (p.map φ) (p.derivative.map φ)
      (by simpa only [← Polynomial.derivative_map] using hsep)
    apply h'
    simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hφ,
      Polynomial.resultant_map_map, d, h, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, _, hab⟩ := Polynomial.exists_mul_add_mul_eq_C_resultant
    p p.derivative le_rfl le_rfl (Or.inl hd)
  refine ⟨d, hd0, fun ψ hψ => ?_⟩
  have hmap : p.map ψ * a.map ψ + (p.map ψ).derivative * b.map ψ = C (ψ d) := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.derivative_map] using congrArg (Polynomial.map ψ) hab
  change IsCoprime (p.map ψ) (p.map ψ).derivative
  refine ⟨C (ψ d)⁻¹ * a.map ψ, C (ψ d)⁻¹ * b.map ψ, ?_⟩
  calc
    C (ψ d)⁻¹ * a.map ψ * p.map ψ + C (ψ d)⁻¹ * b.map ψ * (p.map ψ).derivative =
        C (ψ d)⁻¹ * (p.map ψ * a.map ψ + (p.map ψ).derivative * b.map ψ) := by ring
    _ = C (ψ d)⁻¹ * C (ψ d) := by rw [hmap]
    _ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hψ, map_one]

lemma squarefree_ringEquiv {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) {p : A} (hp : Squarefree p) : Squarefree (e p) := by
  intro q hq
  have hdiv : e.symm q * e.symm q ∣ p := by
    simpa only [map_mul, e.symm_apply_apply] using map_dvd e.symm hq
  have hu := hp (e.symm q) hdiv
  simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hu.map e

noncomputable def axisPoly {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (x : σ → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial σ ℝ →+* ℝ[X] :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom Polynomial.C (fun j => if j = i then Polynomial.X else Polynomial.C (x j))

@[simp] lemma axisPoly_C {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (x : σ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    axisPoly i x (MvPolynomial.C c) = Polynomial.C c := by simp [axisPoly]

@[simp] lemma axisPoly_X {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ) (x : σ → ℝ) :
    axisPoly i x (MvPolynomial.X j) =
      if j = i then Polynomial.X else Polynomial.C (x j) := by simp [axisPoly]

lemma eval_axisPoly {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (x : σ → ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (axisPoly i x p).eval t = MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i t) p := by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hp, Function.update_apply, hji]

noncomputable def splitVariable {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) :
    MvPolynomial σ ℝ ≃ₐ[ℝ] (MvPolynomial {j : σ // j ≠ i} ℝ)[X] :=
  (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℝ (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).symm).trans
    (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft ℝ {j : σ // j ≠ i})

@[simp] lemma splitVariable_C {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (c : ℝ) :
    splitVariable i (MvPolynomial.C c) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
  simp [splitVariable, MvPolynomial.renameEquiv_apply]

@[simp] lemma splitVariable_X_self {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) :
    splitVariable i (MvPolynomial.X i) = Polynomial.X := by
  simp [splitVariable, MvPolynomial.renameEquiv_apply, Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_symm_self]

lemma splitVariable_X_ne {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    splitVariable i (MvPolynomial.X j) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X ⟨j, hji⟩) := by
  simp [splitVariable, MvPolynomial.renameEquiv_apply, Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_symm_of_ne hji]

lemma axisPoly_eq_map_splitVariable {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (x : σ → ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) :
    axisPoly i x p = (splitVariable i p).map (MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => x j.val)) := by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j; simp [hp]
    · simp [hp, hji, splitVariable_X_ne i j hji]

lemma generic_axisPoly {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ]
    {p : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hp : Squarefree p) (i : σ) :
    ∃ d : MvPolynomial σ ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x : σ → ℝ,
      MvPolynomial.eval x d ≠ 0 → (axisPoly i x p).Separable := by
  letI : NormalizedGCDMonoid (MvPolynomial {j : σ // j ≠ i} ℝ) :=
    Classical.choice inferInstance
  have hs : Squarefree (splitVariable i p) :=
    squarefree_ringEquiv (splitVariable i).toRingEquiv hp
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hspec⟩ := generic_polynomial_specialization hs
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Subtype.val d, ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · exact fun h => hd ((MvPolynomial.rename_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective)
      (by simpa only [map_zero] using h))
  · rw [axisPoly_eq_map_splitVariable]
    apply hspec (MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => x j.val))
    simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_rename, Function.comp_def] using hx

lemma finite_polynomial_factorization {σ ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (p : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (MvPolynomial σ ℝ)) (u : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ)
      (e : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ → ℕ),
      Squarefree (∏ r ∈ S, r) ∧ (∀ i, IsUnit (u i)) ∧
      ∀ i, p i = u i * ∏ r ∈ S, r ^ e i r := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  letI : NormalizationMonoid (MvPolynomial σ ℝ) :=
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizationMonoid
  let S := Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (p i)).toFinset)
  have hfac (r : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (hr : r ∈ S) :
      Prime r ∧ normalize r = r := by
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hr
    have hi' := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hi
    exact ⟨UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor r hi',
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalize_normalized_factor r hi'⟩
  have hprod0 : (∏ r ∈ S, r) ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun r hr => (hfac r hr).1.ne_zero)
  have hsq : Squarefree (∏ r ∈ S, r) := by
    apply (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors hprod0).mpr
    have hn := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_prod_eq S.val
      (fun r hr => (hfac r hr).1.irreducible)
    have hid : S.val.map normalize = S.val := by
      calc
        S.val.map normalize = S.val.map (fun r => r) :=
          Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun r hr => (hfac r hr).2)
        _ = S.val := Multiset.map_id' _
    have hnodup : (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors S.val.prod).Nodup := by
      rw [hn, hid]
      exact S.nodup
    simpa only [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_id'] using hnodup
  have hunit (i : ι) : ∃ u : (MvPolynomial σ ℝ)ˣ,
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (p i)).prod * u = p i :=
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors (hp i)
  choose u hu using hunit
  refine ⟨S, fun i => (u i : MvPolynomial σ ℝ),
    fun i r => (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (p i)).count r,
    hsq, fun i => (u i).isUnit, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [← hu i, mul_comm]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_multiset_count_of_subset
  intro r hr
  exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hr⟩

end PierceBirkhoff

/-! Signs and simple roots of finite polynomial products. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

open Polynomial Filter
open scoped Topology

lemma sign_finset_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    SignType.sign (∏ i ∈ s, v i) = ∏ i ∈ s, SignType.sign (v i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [sign_one]
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi, sign_mul, ih]

lemma eventually_sign_eq {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → ℝ} {x : X}
    (hf : ContinuousAt f x) (hx : f x ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, SignType.sign (f y) = SignType.sign (f x) := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with h | h
  · filter_upwards [hf.eventually_lt continuousAt_const h] with y hy
    rw [sign_neg hy, sign_neg h]
  · filter_upwards [continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hf h] with y hy
    rw [sign_pos hy, sign_pos h]

lemma sign_sq_eq_one (s : SignType) (hs : s ≠ 0) : s * s = 1 := by
  cases s <;> simp_all

lemma sign_eq_one_or_neg_one (s : SignType) (hs : s ≠ 0) : s = 1 ∨ s = -1 := by
  cases s <;> simp_all

lemma polynomial_simple_root_pos {p : ℝ[X]} {t : ℝ}
    (hp : p.eval t = 0) (hd : p.derivative.eval t ≠ 0)
    {U : Set ℝ} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 t) : ∃ s ∈ U, 0 < p.eval s := by
  by_contra! h
  have hmax : IsLocalMax (fun s => p.eval s) t := by
    filter_upwards [hU] with s hs
    simpa only [hp] using h s hs
  exact hd (hmax.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (p.hasDerivAt t))

lemma polynomial_simple_root_neg {p : ℝ[X]} {t : ℝ}
    (hp : p.eval t = 0) (hd : p.derivative.eval t ≠ 0)
    {U : Set ℝ} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 t) : ∃ s ∈ U, p.eval s < 0 := by
  by_contra! h
  have hmin : IsLocalMin (fun s => p.eval s) t := by
    filter_upwards [hU] with s hs
    simpa only [hp] using h s hs
  exact hd (hmin.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (p.hasDerivAt t))

lemma separable_prod_unique_root {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ[X]) (hsep : (∏ i ∈ s, p i).Separable)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : (∏ i ∈ s, p i).eval t = 0) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, (p i).eval t = 0 ∧
      (∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → (p j).eval t ≠ 0) ∧ (p i).derivative.eval t ≠ 0 := by
  have ht' : ∏ i ∈ s, (p i).eval t = 0 := by simpa only [Polynomial.eval_prod] using ht
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hit⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp ht'
  have hd : (∏ i ∈ s, p i).derivative.eval t ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval₂_id] using
      hsep.eval₂_derivative_ne_zero (RingHom.id ℝ) (by simpa only [Polynomial.eval₂_id] using ht)
  have heq := Finset.mul_prod_erase s p hi
  have hderiv : (p i).derivative.eval t * (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, p j).eval t ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [← heq, Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, hit, zero_mul, add_zero] using hd
  refine ⟨i, hi, hit, ?_, (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hderiv).1⟩
  intro j hj hji
  have hrest : ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (p j).eval t ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_prod] using (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hderiv).2
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hrest j (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hji, hj⟩)

lemma unit_eval_ne_zero {σ : Type*} {u : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hu : IsUnit u)
    (x : σ → ℝ) : MvPolynomial.eval x u ≠ 0 :=
  (hu.map (MvPolynomial.eval x)).ne_zero

lemma factorized_eval_ne_zero {σ : Type*} (S : Finset (MvPolynomial σ ℝ))
    {p u : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {e : MvPolynomial σ ℝ → ℕ}
    (hu : IsUnit u) (hp : p = u * ∏ r ∈ S, r ^ e r)
    {x : σ → ℝ} (hx : ∀ r ∈ S, MvPolynomial.eval x r ≠ 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x p ≠ 0 := by
  rw [hp, map_mul, map_prod]
  apply mul_ne_zero (unit_eval_ne_zero hu x)
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro r hr
  simpa only [map_pow] using pow_ne_zero (e r) (hx r hr)

lemma factorized_split {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] [DecidableEq A]
    (S : Finset A) {r : A} (hr : r ∈ S) (u : A) (e : A → ℕ) :
    u * ∏ q ∈ S, q ^ e q = r ^ e r * (u * ∏ q ∈ S.erase r, q ^ e q) := by
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase S (fun q => q ^ e q) hr]
  ac_rfl

lemma factorized_dvd_of_eval_zero {σ : Type*}
    (S : Finset (MvPolynomial σ ℝ)) {r p u : MvPolynomial σ ℝ}
    {e : MvPolynomial σ ℝ → ℕ} (hr : r ∈ S)
    (hu : IsUnit u) (hp : p = u * ∏ q ∈ S, q ^ e q)
    {x : σ → ℝ} (hothers : ∀ q ∈ S, q ≠ r → MvPolynomial.eval x q ≠ 0)
    (hpx : MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0) : r ∣ p := by
  classical
  have hc : MvPolynomial.eval x (u * ∏ q ∈ S.erase r, q ^ e q) ≠ 0 := by
    apply factorized_eval_ne_zero (S.erase r) hu rfl
    intro q hq
    exact hothers q (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).2 (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).1
  have hp' : p = r ^ e r * (u * ∏ q ∈ S.erase r, q ^ e q) :=
    hp.trans (factorized_split S hr u e)
  have he : e r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [hp', h, pow_zero, one_mul] at hpx
    exact hc hpx
  rw [hp']
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self r he) _

lemma polynomial_nonzero_dense {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Dense {t : ℝ | p.eval t ≠ 0} := by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro x ε hε
  by_contra h
  apply hp
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot p
  apply (Set.Ioo_infinite (a := x - ε) (b := x + ε) (by linarith)).mono
  intro t ht
  change p.eval t = 0
  by_contra hn
  apply h
  refine ⟨t, ?_, hn⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]

end PierceBirkhoff

/-! Topological constancy lemmas on dense sets. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

lemma constant_of_dense_local {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [PreconnectedSpace X]
    {S : Set X} (hS : Dense S) (u : X → Y)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∀ a ∈ U ∩ S, ∀ b ∈ U ∩ S, u a = u b) :
    ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, u a = u b := by
  classical
  choose U hU hxU hu using hlocal
  have hne (x : X) : (U x ∩ S).Nonempty :=
    hS.inter_open_nonempty (U x) (hU x) ⟨x, hxU x⟩
  let v (x : X) : Y := u (hne x).choose
  have hv (x a : X) (ha : a ∈ U x ∩ S) : v x = u a :=
    hu x _ (hne x).choose_spec a ha
  have heq (x y : X) (hy : y ∈ U x) : v y = v x := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, haS⟩ := hS.inter_open_nonempty (U x ∩ U y)
      ((hU x).inter (hU y)) ⟨y, hy, hxU y⟩
    exact (hv y a ⟨ha.2, haS⟩).trans (hv x a ⟨ha.1, haS⟩).symm
  have hvlocal : IsLocallyConstant v := by
    apply (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open v).mpr
    intro x
    exact ⟨U x, hU x, hxU x, fun y hy => heq x y hy⟩
  intro a ha b hb
  have hconst : v a = v b := hvlocal.apply_eq_of_isPreconnected
    isPreconnected_univ (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _)
  exact (hv a a ⟨hxU a, ha⟩).symm.trans (hconst.trans (hv b b ⟨hxU b, hb⟩))

open Filter
open scoped Topology

lemma coordinate_constancy_of_generic {σ Y : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (Q : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (u : (σ → ℝ) → Y)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, u z = u x)
    (hgeneric : ∀ i : σ, ∃ d : MvPolynomial σ ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x d ≠ 0 → ∀ t s : ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i t) Q ≠ 0 →
        MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i s) Q ≠ 0 →
        u (Function.update x i t) = u (Function.update x i s)) :
    ∀ (i : σ) (x : σ → ℝ) (t s : ℝ),
      MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i t) Q ≠ 0 →
      MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i s) Q ≠ 0 →
      u (Function.update x i t) = u (Function.update x i s) := by
  intro i x t s ht hs
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hg⟩ := hgeneric i
  have ht' : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x,
      MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update z i t) Q ≠ 0 ∧
        u (Function.update z i t) = u (Function.update x i t) :=
    (continuous_id.update i continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually
      (((MvPolynomial.continuous_eval Q).continuousAt.eventually_ne ht).and
        (hlocal _ ht))
  have hs' : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x,
      MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update z i s) Q ≠ 0 ∧
        u (Function.update z i s) = u (Function.update x i s) :=
    (continuous_id.update i continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually
      (((MvPolynomial.continuous_eval Q).continuousAt.eventually_ne hs).and
        (hlocal _ hs))
  obtain ⟨z, hzd, hzt, hzs⟩ := (mvPolynomial_nonzero_dense hd).inter_nhds_nonempty
    (ht'.and hs')
  exact hzt.2.symm.trans ((hg z hzd t s hzt.1 hzs.1).trans hzs.2)

def mixCoordinates {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (x z : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  if j.val < k then z j else x j

@[simp] lemma mixCoordinates_zero {n : ℕ} (x z : Fin n → ℝ) :
    mixCoordinates 0 x z = x := by funext j; simp [mixCoordinates]

@[simp] lemma mixCoordinates_self {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    mixCoordinates k x x = x := by funext j; simp [mixCoordinates]

@[simp] lemma mixCoordinates_all {n : ℕ} (x z : Fin n → ℝ) :
    mixCoordinates n x z = z := by funext j; simp [mixCoordinates, j.isLt]

lemma mixCoordinates_succ {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) (x z : Fin n → ℝ) :
    mixCoordinates (k + 1) x z =
      Function.update (mixCoordinates k x z) ⟨k, hk⟩ (z ⟨k, hk⟩) := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = ⟨k, hk⟩
  · subst j; simp [mixCoordinates]
  · have hjv : j.val ≠ k := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
    have hlt : j.val < k + 1 ↔ j.val < k := by omega
    simp [mixCoordinates, Function.update_apply, hj, hlt]

noncomputable def cornerPoly {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom MvPolynomial.C
    (fun j => if j.val < k then MvPolynomial.X j else MvPolynomial.C (x j))

lemma eval_cornerPoly {n : ℕ} (x z : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval z (cornerPoly x k p) = MvPolynomial.eval (mixCoordinates k x z) p := by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp [cornerPoly]
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    by_cases hj : j.val < k <;> simp [cornerPoly, mixCoordinates, hj] at hp ⊢
    all_goals simp only [hp, true_or]

lemma cornerPoly_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} (hx : MvPolynomial.eval x p ≠ 0) :
    cornerPoly x k p ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval x) h
  rw [eval_cornerPoly, mixCoordinates_self, map_zero] at this
  exact hx this

lemma constant_on_polynomial_complement_of_coordinates {n : ℕ} {Y : Type*}
    (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (u : (Fin n → ℝ) → Y)
    (hcoord : ∀ (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t s : ℝ),
      MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i t) Q ≠ 0 →
      MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i s) Q ≠ 0 →
      u (Function.update x i t) = u (Function.update x i s)) :
    ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≠ 0 → ∀ y, MvPolynomial.eval y Q ≠ 0 → u x = u y := by
  classical
  have hpath (x z : Fin n → ℝ)
      (hxz : ∀ k ≤ n, MvPolynomial.eval (mixCoordinates k x z) Q ≠ 0) : u x = u z := by
    have hind : ∀ k, k ≤ n → u x = u (mixCoordinates k x z) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro _; simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro hk
        have hkn : k < n := by omega
        apply (ih (by omega)).trans
        have h := hcoord ⟨k, hkn⟩ (mixCoordinates k x z)
          ((mixCoordinates k x z) ⟨k, hkn⟩) (z ⟨k, hkn⟩)
        rw [Function.update_eq_self, ← mixCoordinates_succ hkn] at h
        exact h (hxz k (by omega)) (hxz (k + 1) hk)
    simpa only [mixCoordinates_all] using hind n le_rfl
  intro x hx y hy
  let T : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ :=
    ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), cornerPoly x k Q * cornerPoly y k Q
  have hT : T ≠ 0 := by
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro k _
    exact mul_ne_zero (cornerPoly_ne_zero x k hx) (cornerPoly_ne_zero y k hy)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (mvPolynomial_nonzero_dense hT).nonempty
  have hz' : ∀ k ≤ n, MvPolynomial.eval (mixCoordinates k x z) Q ≠ 0 ∧
      MvPolynomial.eval (mixCoordinates k y z) Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hprod : ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval z (cornerPoly x k Q) * MvPolynomial.eval z (cornerPoly y k Q) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [T, map_prod, map_mul] using hz
    have h := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod k (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    simpa only [mul_ne_zero_iff, eval_cornerPoly] using h
  exact (hpath x z (fun k hk => (hz' k hk).1)).trans
    (hpath y z (fun k hk => (hz' k hk).2)).symm

end PierceBirkhoff

/-! Finite polynomial separators from paths of sign-changing common factors. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

noncomputable def factorQuotient {σ : Type*}
    (r d : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) : MvPolynomial σ ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : r ∣ d then h.choose else 0

lemma factorQuotient_spec {σ : Type*} {r d : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (h : r ∣ d) :
    d = r * factorQuotient r d := by
  simp only [factorQuotient, dif_pos h]
  exact h.choose_spec

def factorGraph {σ ι ρ : Type*} (g : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ)
    (r : ρ → MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (x y : σ → ℝ) : SimpleGraph ι where
  Adj i j := i ≠ j ∧ ∃ k, r k ∣ g i - g j ∧
    MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) * MvPolynomial.eval y (r k) < 0
  symm := by
    intro i j h
    obtain ⟨hne, k, hdiv, hsign⟩ := h
    refine ⟨hne.symm, k, ?_, hsign⟩
    simpa only [neg_sub] using dvd_neg.mpr hdiv
  loopless := by intro i h; exact h.1 rfl

lemma walk_abs_bound {ι : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph ι) (v : ι → ℝ) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hedge : ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → |v i - v j| ≤ B)
    {a b : ι} (w : G.Walk a b) : |v a - v b| ≤ (w.length : ℝ) * B := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons a b c hab w ih =>
    calc
      |v a - v c| ≤ |v a - v b| + |v b - v c| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
      _ ≤ B + (w.length : ℝ) * B := add_le_add (hedge a b hab) ih
      _ = ((SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab w).length : ℝ) * B := by
        simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        ring

lemma reachable_abs_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (G : SimpleGraph ι)
    (v : ι → ℝ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hedge : ∀ i j, G.Adj i j → |v i - v j| ≤ B)
    {a b : ι} (h : G.Reachable a b) :
    |v a - v b| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * B := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h.exists_isPath
  apply (walk_abs_bound G v hB hedge w).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hB
  exact_mod_cast hw.length_lt.le

lemma sign_left_mul_of_mul_neg {a b : ℝ} (h : a * b < 0) :
    (SignType.sign a : ℝ) * b = -|b| := by
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp h with h | h
  · simp [sign_pos h.1, abs_of_neg h.2]
  · simp [sign_neg h.1, abs_of_pos h.2]

lemma abs_le_one_add_square (x : ℝ) : |x| ≤ 1 + x ^ 2 := by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 1), sq_nonneg (x + 1), sq_nonneg x]

lemma finite_factor_separators {σ ι ρ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype ρ]
    (g : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (r : ρ → MvPolynomial σ ℝ)
    (f : (σ → ℝ) → ℝ) (l : (σ → ℝ) → ι) (S : Set (σ → ℝ))
    (hlabel : ∀ x ∈ S, f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g (l x)))
    (hreach : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, (factorGraph g r x y).Reachable (l x) (l y)) :
    ∃ (τ : Type) (p : τ → MvPolynomial σ ℝ), Finite τ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∃ t, f x ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (p t) ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval y (p t) ≤ f y := by
  classical
  let q (k : ρ) (ij : ι × ι) := factorQuotient (r k) (g ij.1 - g ij.2)
  let H (k : ρ) : MvPolynomial σ ℝ := 1 + ∑ ij : ι × ι, (q k ij) ^ 2
  have hH (k : ρ) (z : σ → ℝ) :
      MvPolynomial.eval z (H k) = 1 + ∑ ij : ι × ι, (MvPolynomial.eval z (q k ij)) ^ 2 := by
    simp [H]
  have hHpos (k : ρ) (z : σ → ℝ) : 0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval z (H k) := by
    rw [hH]
    positivity
  have hqH (k : ρ) (ij : ι × ι) (z : σ → ℝ) :
      |MvPolynomial.eval z (q k ij)| ≤ MvPolynomial.eval z (H k) := by
    apply (abs_le_one_add_square _).trans
    rw [hH]
    exact add_le_add le_rfl (Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun ij' _ => sq_nonneg (MvPolynomial.eval z (q k ij')))
      (Finset.mem_univ ij))
  have hdiff (k : ρ) (i j : ι) (z : σ → ℝ) (hk : r k ∣ g i - g j) :
      |MvPolynomial.eval z (g i) - MvPolynomial.eval z (g j)| ≤
        |MvPolynomial.eval z (r k)| * MvPolynomial.eval z (H k) := by
    have hd := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval z) (factorQuotient_spec hk)
    change MvPolynomial.eval z (g i - g j) =
      MvPolynomial.eval z (r k * q k (i, j)) at hd
    rw [map_sub, map_mul] at hd
    rw [hd, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hqH k (i, j) z) (abs_nonneg _)
  let p (a : ι × (ρ → SignType)) : MvPolynomial σ ℝ :=
    g a.1 + MvPolynomial.C (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) *
      ∑ k : ρ, MvPolynomial.C (a.2 k : ℝ) * r k * H k
  refine ⟨ι × (ρ → SignType), p, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  let changed (k : ρ) : Prop := MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) * MvPolynomial.eval y (r k) < 0
  let s (k : ρ) : SignType := if changed k then SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x (r k)) else 0
  let B : ℝ := ∑ k : ρ, if changed k then
    |MvPolynomial.eval y (r k)| * MvPolynomial.eval y (H k) else 0
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro k _
    dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hHpos k y)
    · exact le_rfl
  have hedge (i j : ι) (hij : (factorGraph g r x y).Adj i j) :
      |MvPolynomial.eval y (g i) - MvPolynomial.eval y (g j)| ≤ B := by
    obtain ⟨_, k, hk, hks⟩ := hij
    apply (hdiff k i j y hk).trans
    have hterm := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun k : ρ => if changed k then
        |MvPolynomial.eval y (r k)| * MvPolynomial.eval y (H k) else 0)
      (fun k _ => by dsimp only; split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hHpos k y); exact le_rfl)
      (Finset.mem_univ k)
    simpa only [changed, if_pos hks, B] using hterm
  have hbound := reachable_abs_bound (factorGraph g r x y)
    (fun i => MvPolynomial.eval y (g i)) hB hedge (hreach x hx y hy)
  have hsumx : 0 ≤ ∑ k : ρ,
      (s k : ℝ) * MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) * MvPolynomial.eval x (H k) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro k _
    dsimp only [s]
    split_ifs
    · simpa only [sign_mul_self] using mul_nonneg
        (abs_nonneg (MvPolynomial.eval x (r k))) (hHpos k x)
    · simp
  have hsumy : (∑ k : ρ,
      (s k : ℝ) * MvPolynomial.eval y (r k) * MvPolynomial.eval y (H k)) = -B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    dsimp only [s]
    split_ifs with hk
    · rw [sign_left_mul_of_mul_neg hk, neg_mul]
    · simp
  refine ⟨(l x, s), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hlabel x hx]
    simp only [p, map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_C, map_sum]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hsumx)
  · simp only [p, map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_C, map_sum]
    rw [hsumy, hlabel y hy]
    have := le_abs_self (MvPolynomial.eval y (g (l x)) - MvPolynomial.eval y (g (l y)))
    nlinarith

end PierceBirkhoff

/-! The sign invariant for an atomic polynomial selection on a generic coordinate fiber. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

open Polynomial Filter
open scoped Topology

noncomputable def colorSign {ι : Type*} (C : Set ι) (i : ι) : SignType := by
  classical
  exact if i ∈ C then 1 else -1

def atomBoundary {α ι ρ : Type*} (e : α → ρ → ℕ) (lab : α → ι)
    (D : ρ → ι → ι → Prop) (C : Set ι) (k : ρ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b, Odd (e a k) ∧ Odd (e b k) ∧ lab a ∈ C ∧ lab b ∉ C ∧ D k (lab a) (lab b)

noncomputable def boundaryProduct {α ι ρ A : Type*} [Fintype ρ] [CommMonoid A]
    (e : α → ρ → ℕ) (lab : α → ι) (D : ρ → ι → ι → Prop) (C : Set ι)
    (r : ρ → A) : A := by
  classical
  exact ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (atomBoundary e lab D C), r k

lemma atomic_fiber_invariant {α ι ρ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype ρ]
    (p u : α → ℝ[X]) (r : ρ → ℝ[X]) (e : α → ρ → ℕ) (lab : α → ι)
    (D : ρ → ι → ι → Prop) (C : Set ι)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (l : ℝ → ι)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hv : ∀ i, Continuous (v i))
    (hselect : ∀ t, f t = v (l t) t)
    (hu : ∀ a t, (u a).eval t ≠ 0)
    (hfactor : ∀ a, p a = u a * ∏ k : ρ, r k ^ e a k)
    (hsep : (∏ k : ρ, r k).Separable)
    (hcover : ∀ t, (∀ k, (r k).eval t ≠ 0) → ∃ a, 0 < (p a).eval t)
    (hlab : ∀ a t, (∀ k, (r k).eval t ≠ 0) → 0 < (p a).eval t → lab a = l t)
    (hD : ∀ k t, (r k).eval t = 0 → (∀ j, j ≠ k → (r j).eval t ≠ 0) →
      ∀ i j, v i t = v j t → D k i j) :
    let Q := boundaryProduct e lab D C r
    ∀ x, (∀ k, (r k).eval x ≠ 0) → ∀ y, (∀ k, (r k).eval y ≠ 0) →
      colorSign C (l x) * SignType.sign (Q.eval x) =
        colorSign C (l y) * SignType.sign (Q.eval y) := by
  classical
  dsimp only [boundaryProduct]
  let B := atomBoundary e lab D C
  let T : Finset ρ := Finset.univ.filter B
  let Q : ℝ[X] := ∏ k ∈ T, r k
  let S : Set ℝ := {t | ∀ k, (r k).eval t ≠ 0}
  let w (t : ℝ) := colorSign C (l t) * SignType.sign (Q.eval t)
  have hSd : Dense S := by
    have h := polynomial_nonzero_dense hsep.squarefree.ne_zero
    simpa only [S, Polynomial.eval_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_implies] using h
  change ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, w x = w y
  apply constant_of_dense_local hSd w
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ S
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcover t ht
    have hlt : lab a = l t := hlab a t ht ha
    have hQ0 : Q.eval t ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun k _ => ht k)
    have hevent : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 t,
        0 < (p a).eval z ∧ SignType.sign (Q.eval z) = SignType.sign (Q.eval t) :=
      (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (p a).continuous.continuousAt ha).and
        (eventually_sign_eq Q.continuous.continuousAt hQ0)
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hUo, htU⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hevent
    refine ⟨U, hUo, htU, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    have hx' := hU hx.1
    have hy' := hU hy.1
    have hlx : l x = lab a := (hlab a x hx.2 hx'.1).symm
    have hly : l y = lab a := (hlab a y hy.2 hy'.1).symm
    simp only [w, hlx, hly, hx'.2, hy'.2]
  · have htotal : (∏ k : ρ, r k).eval t = 0 := by
      apply not_ne_iff.mp
      simpa only [S, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_prod,
        Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_implies, not_not] using ht
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk0, hothers', hkd⟩ := separable_prod_unique_root Finset.univ r hsep htotal
    have hothers : ∀ j, j ≠ k → (r j).eval t ≠ 0 := fun j hj =>
      hothers' j (Finset.mem_univ j) hj
    let c (a : α) : ℝ[X] := u a * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, r j ^ e a j
    have hsplit (a : α) : p a = r k ^ e a k * c a := by
      rw [hfactor a, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => r j ^ e a j) (Finset.mem_univ k)]
      dsimp only [c]
      ring
    have hc0 (a : α) : (c a).eval t ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [c, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_pow]
      apply mul_ne_zero (hu a t)
      exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j hj => pow_ne_zero _
        (hothers j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1))
    let Qrest : ℝ[X] := ∏ j ∈ T.erase k, r j
    have hQrest0 : Qrest.eval t ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j hj => hothers j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
    have hQsplit : Q = if B k then r k * Qrest else Qrest := by
      by_cases hkB : B k
      · rw [if_pos hkB]
        exact (Finset.mul_prod_erase T r (by simp [T, hkB])).symm
      · rw [if_neg hkB]
        simp only [Q, Qrest, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem (show k ∉ T by simp [T, hkB])]
    have hcEvent : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 t, ∀ a : α,
        SignType.sign ((c a).eval z) = SignType.sign ((c a).eval t) :=
      Filter.eventually_all.mpr (fun a => eventually_sign_eq (c a).continuous.continuousAt (hc0 a))
    have hoEvent : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 t, ∀ j : ρ, j ≠ k → (r j).eval z ≠ 0 := by
      apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
      intro j
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z h => False.elim (h hj))
      · filter_upwards [(r j).continuous.continuousAt.eventually_ne (hothers j hj)] with z hz _
        exact hz
    have hqEvent := eventually_sign_eq Qrest.continuous.continuousAt hQrest0
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hUo, htU⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (hcEvent.and (hoEvent.and hqEvent))
    have hUn : U ∈ 𝓝 t := hUo.mem_nhds htU
    have hgood (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ U) (hrz : (r k).eval z ≠ 0) : z ∈ S := by
      intro j
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · simpa only [hj] using hrz
      · exact (hU hz).2.1 j hj
    have hsign (a : α) (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ U) :
        SignType.sign ((p a).eval z) =
          SignType.sign ((c a).eval t) * SignType.sign ((r k).eval z) ^ e a k := by
      rw [hsplit, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, sign_mul, sign_pow,
        (hU hz).1 a, mul_comm]
    have hQsign (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ U) : SignType.sign (Q.eval z) =
        (if B k then SignType.sign ((r k).eval z) else 1) * SignType.sign (Qrest.eval t) := by
      rw [hQsplit]
      split_ifs <;> simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, sign_mul, (hU hz).2.2, one_mul]
    obtain ⟨xp, hxpU, hxp⟩ := polynomial_simple_root_pos hk0 hkd hUn
    obtain ⟨xm, hxmU, hxm⟩ := polynomial_simple_root_neg hk0 hkd hUn
    have hxpg : xp ∈ S := hgood xp hxpU (ne_of_gt hxp)
    have hxmg : xm ∈ S := hgood xm hxmU (ne_of_lt hxm)
    obtain ⟨ap, hap⟩ := hcover xp hxpg
    obtain ⟨am, ham⟩ := hcover xm hxmg
    have hlap := hlab ap xp hxpg hap
    have hlam := hlab am xm hxmg ham
    have hlplus (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ U) (hzg : z ∈ S)
        (hzs : SignType.sign ((r k).eval z) = 1) : l z = l xp := by
      have hpos : 0 < (p ap).eval z := by
        apply sign_eq_one_iff.mp
        calc
          SignType.sign ((p ap).eval z) = SignType.sign ((p ap).eval xp) := by
            rw [hsign ap z hz, hsign ap xp hxpU, hzs, sign_pos hxp]
          _ = 1 := sign_pos hap
      exact (hlab ap z hzg hpos).symm.trans hlap
    have hlminus (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ U) (hzg : z ∈ S)
        (hzs : SignType.sign ((r k).eval z) = -1) : l z = l xm := by
      have hpos : 0 < (p am).eval z := by
        apply sign_eq_one_iff.mp
        calc
          SignType.sign ((p am).eval z) = SignType.sign ((p am).eval xm) := by
            rw [hsign am z hz, hsign am xm hxmU, hzs, sign_neg hxm]
          _ = 1 := sign_pos ham
      exact (hlab am z hzg hpos).symm.trans hlam
    have hodd (a : α) (ha : Odd (e a k)) : lab a = l xp ∨ lab a = l xm := by
      rcases sign_eq_one_or_neg_one (SignType.sign ((c a).eval t))
        (sign_ne_zero.mpr (hc0 a)) with hc | hc
      · left
        apply hlab a xp hxpg
        apply sign_eq_one_iff.mp
        rw [hsign a xp hxpU, sign_pos hxp, hc]
        simp
      · right
        apply hlab a xm hxmg
        apply sign_eq_one_iff.mp
        rw [hsign a xm hxmU, sign_neg hxm, SignType.pow_odd _ ha, hc]
        simp
    have heven (a : α) (ha : Even (e a k)) :
        SignType.sign ((p a).eval xp) = SignType.sign ((p a).eval xm) := by
      rw [hsign a xp hxpU, hsign a xm hxmU, sign_pos hxp, sign_neg hxm,
        SignType.pow_even (1 : SignType) ha (by decide),
        SignType.pow_even (-1 : SignType) ha (by decide)]
    have hop (hne : l xp ≠ l xm) : Odd (e ap k) := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd (e ap k) with he | ho
      · have hpos : 0 < (p ap).eval xm := sign_eq_one_iff.mp ((heven ap he).symm.trans (sign_pos hap))
        exact False.elim (hne (hlap.symm.trans (hlab ap xm hxmg hpos)))
      · exact ho
    have hom (hne : l xp ≠ l xm) : Odd (e am k) := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd (e am k) with he | ho
      · have hpos : 0 < (p am).eval xp := sign_eq_one_iff.mp ((heven am he).trans (sign_pos ham))
        exact False.elim (hne ((hlab am xp hxpg hpos).symm.trans hlam))
      · exact ho
    have hrootp : f t = v (l xp) t := by
      apply tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq hf.continuousAt (hv (l xp)).continuousAt
      apply Filter.frequently_iff.mpr
      intro V hV
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hrz⟩ := polynomial_simple_root_pos hk0 hkd (Filter.inter_mem hV hUn)
      refine ⟨z, hz.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hselect z, hlplus z hz.2 (hgood z hz.2 (ne_of_gt hrz)) (sign_pos hrz)]
    have hrootm : f t = v (l xm) t := by
      apply tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq hf.continuousAt (hv (l xm)).continuousAt
      apply Filter.frequently_iff.mpr
      intro V hV
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hrz⟩ := polynomial_simple_root_neg hk0 hkd (Filter.inter_mem hV hUn)
      refine ⟨z, hz.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hselect z, hlminus z hz.2 (hgood z hz.2 (ne_of_lt hrz)) (sign_neg hrz)]
    have hDpm := hD k t hk0 hothers (l xp) (l xm) (hrootp.symm.trans hrootm)
    have hDmp := hD k t hk0 hothers (l xm) (l xp) (hrootm.symm.trans hrootp)
    have hbiff : B k ↔ (l xp ∈ C ∧ l xm ∉ C) ∨ (l xm ∈ C ∧ l xp ∉ C) := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hCa, hCb, _⟩
        rcases hodd a ha with hla | hla <;> rcases hodd b hb with hlb | hlb <;>
          rw [hla] at hCa <;> rw [hlb] at hCb <;> tauto
      · intro h
        have hne : l xp ≠ l xm := by
          intro heq
          rcases h with h | h
          · exact h.2 (heq ▸ h.1)
          · exact h.2 (heq.symm ▸ h.1)
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact ⟨ap, am, hop hne, hom hne, by simpa only [hlap] using h.1,
            by simpa only [hlam] using h.2, by simpa only [hlap, hlam] using hDpm⟩
        · exact ⟨am, ap, hom hne, hop hne, by simpa only [hlam] using h.1,
            by simpa only [hlap] using h.2, by simpa only [hlap, hlam] using hDmp⟩
    have hcolor : colorSign C (l xm) * (if B k then -1 else 1) = colorSign C (l xp) := by
      by_cases hpC : l xp ∈ C <;> by_cases hmC : l xm ∈ C <;>
        simp [colorSign, hbiff, hpC, hmC]
    have hw (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ U ∩ S) :
        w z = colorSign C (l xp) * SignType.sign (Qrest.eval t) := by
      rcases sign_eq_one_or_neg_one (SignType.sign ((r k).eval z))
        (sign_ne_zero.mpr (hz.2 k)) with hs | hs
      · dsimp only [w]
        rw [hlplus z hz.1 hz.2 hs, hQsign z hz.1, hs]
        simp
      · dsimp only [w]
        rw [hlminus z hz.1 hz.2 hs, hQsign z hz.1, hs, ← mul_assoc, hcolor]
    exact ⟨U, hUo, htU, fun x hx y hy => (hw x hx).trans (hw y hy).symm⟩

end PierceBirkhoff

namespace PierceBirkhoff

open Filter
open scoped Topology

lemma atomic_global_invariant {n : ℕ} {α ι ρ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype ρ]
    (p u : α → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ρ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (e : α → ρ → ℕ) (lab : α → ι) (g : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (D : ρ → ι → ι → Prop) (C : Set ι)
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (l : (Fin n → ℝ) → ι)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hselect : ∀ x, f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g (l x)))
    (hu : ∀ a, IsUnit (u a))
    (hfactor : ∀ a, p a = u a * ∏ k : ρ, r k ^ e a k)
    (hsq : Squarefree (∏ k : ρ, r k))
    (hcover : ∀ x, (∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0) → ∃ a, 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a))
    (hlab : ∀ a x, (∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0) →
      0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a) → lab a = l x)
    (hD : ∀ k x, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) = 0 →
      (∀ j, j ≠ k → MvPolynomial.eval x (r j) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ i j, MvPolynomial.eval x (g i) = MvPolynomial.eval x (g j) → D k i j) :
    ∀ x, (∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ y, (∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval y (r k) ≠ 0) →
      colorSign C (l x) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x (boundaryProduct e lab D C r)) =
      colorSign C (l y) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y (boundaryProduct e lab D C r)) := by
  classical
  let Q := ∏ k : ρ, r k
  let b := boundaryProduct e lab D C r
  let w (x : Fin n → ℝ) := colorSign C (l x) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x b)
  have hQ (x : Fin n → ℝ) : MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0 := by simp only [Q, map_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_implies]
  have hb (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0) :
      MvPolynomial.eval x b ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [b, boundaryProduct, map_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun k _ => hx k)
  have hlocal : ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, w z = w x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcover x ((hQ x).mp hx)
    have hla := hlab a x ((hQ x).mp hx) ha
    filter_upwards [(MvPolynomial.continuous_eval Q).continuousAt.eventually_ne hx,
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval (p a)).continuousAt ha,
      eventually_sign_eq (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval b).continuousAt (hb x ((hQ x).mp hx))]
      with z hz hza hzb
    have hlz := hlab a z ((hQ z).mp hz) hza
    simp only [w, ← hlz, ← hla, hzb]
  have hg : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ d : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x d ≠ 0 → ∀ t s : ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i t) Q ≠ 0 →
        MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i s) Q ≠ 0 →
        w (Function.update x i t) = w (Function.update x i s) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hsep⟩ := generic_axisPoly hsq i
    refine ⟨d, hd, fun x hx t s ht hs => ?_⟩
    have haxis : (∏ k : ρ, axisPoly i x (r k)).Separable := by
      simpa only [map_prod] using hsep x hx
    have hfac (a : α) : axisPoly i x (p a) =
        axisPoly i x (u a) * ∏ k : ρ, axisPoly i x (r k) ^ e a k := by
      rw [hfactor, map_mul, map_prod]
      simp only [map_pow]
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Function.update x i t) :=
      continuous_const.update i continuous_id
    have h := atomic_fiber_invariant (fun a => axisPoly i x (p a))
      (fun a => axisPoly i x (u a)) (fun k => axisPoly i x (r k)) e lab D C
      (fun t => f (Function.update x i t))
      (fun j t => MvPolynomial.eval (Function.update x i t) (g j))
      (fun t => l (Function.update x i t)) (hf.comp hcont)
      (fun j => (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval (g j)).comp hcont)
      (fun t => hselect _) (fun a t => by
        rw [eval_axisPoly]; exact unit_eval_ne_zero (hu a) _)
      hfac haxis
      (fun t h => by
        simp only [eval_axisPoly] at h ⊢
        exact hcover _ h)
      (fun a t h hp => by
        simp only [eval_axisPoly] at h hp
        exact hlab a _ h hp)
      (fun k t hk ho a b hab => by
        simp only [eval_axisPoly] at hk ho
        exact hD k _ hk ho a b hab)
    have hbaxis : boundaryProduct e lab D C (fun k => axisPoly i x (r k)) = axisPoly i x b := by
      simp only [b, boundaryProduct, map_prod]
    have ht' : ∀ k, (axisPoly i x (r k)).eval t ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [eval_axisPoly] using (hQ _).mp ht
    have hs' : ∀ k, (axisPoly i x (r k)).eval s ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [eval_axisPoly] using (hQ _).mp hs
    have heq := h t ht' s hs'
    simpa only [hbaxis, eval_axisPoly, w] using heq
  have hc := constant_on_polynomial_complement_of_coordinates Q w
    (coordinate_constancy_of_generic Q w hlocal hg)
  intro x hx y hy
  exact hc x ((hQ x).mpr hx) y ((hQ y).mpr hy)

lemma sign_eq_of_not_mul_neg {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ¬a * b < 0) : SignType.sign a = SignType.sign b := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with ha | ha <;> rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hb with hb | hb
  · rw [sign_neg ha, sign_neg hb]
  · exact False.elim (h (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos ha hb))
  · exact False.elim (h (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha hb))
  · rw [sign_pos ha, sign_pos hb]

lemma reachable_of_atomic_invariant {n : ℕ} {α ι ρ : Type} [Fintype ρ]
    (g : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (r : ρ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (e : α → ρ → ℕ) (lab : α → ι) (l : (Fin n → ℝ) → ι)
    (x y : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0)
    (hy : ∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval y (r k) ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ C : Set ι,
      colorSign C (l x) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x
        (boundaryProduct e lab (fun k i j => r k ∣ g i - g j) C r)) =
      colorSign C (l y) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y
        (boundaryProduct e lab (fun k i j => r k ∣ g i - g j) C r))) :
    (factorGraph g r x y).Reachable (l x) (l y) := by
  classical
  let G := factorGraph g r x y
  let C : Set ι := {i | G.Reachable (l x) i}
  let D := fun k i j => r k ∣ g i - g j
  have hlx : l x ∈ C := SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
  have hsame (k : ρ) (hk : atomBoundary e lab D C k) :
      SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x (r k)) = SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y (r k)) := by
    apply sign_eq_of_not_mul_neg (hx k) (hy k)
    intro hneg
    obtain ⟨a, b, _, _, ha, hb, hd⟩ := hk
    have hne : lab a ≠ lab b := fun h => hb (h ▸ ha)
    have hedge : G.Adj (lab a) (lab b) := ⟨hne, k, hd, hneg⟩
    exact hb (ha.trans hedge.reachable)
  let T := Finset.univ.filter (atomBoundary e lab D C)
  let q := boundaryProduct e lab D C r
  have hq : SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x q) = SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y q) := by
    simp only [q, boundaryProduct, map_prod, sign_finset_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    exact hsame k (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  have hq0 : SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y q) ≠ 0 := by
    apply sign_ne_zero.mpr
    simp only [q, boundaryProduct, map_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun k _ => hy k)
  have heq := hinv C
  change colorSign C (l x) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x q) =
    colorSign C (l y) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y q) at heq
  rw [hq] at heq
  have hcolor : colorSign C (l x) = colorSign C (l y) := by
    have := congrArg (fun s : SignType => s * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y q)) heq
    simpa only [mul_assoc, sign_sq_eq_one _ hq0, mul_one] using this
  by_contra hly
  have hly' : l y ∉ C := hly
  simp [colorSign, hlx, hly'] at hcolor

end PierceBirkhoff

/-! Finite lattice representation for atomic polynomial selections. -/

namespace PierceBirkhoff

lemma atomic_selection_representation {n : ℕ} {α ι : Type} [Finite α] [Finite ι]
    (p : α → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (g : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (lab : α → ι) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, p a ≠ 0) (hg : Function.Injective g) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (l : (Fin n → ℝ) → ι)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hselect : ∀ x, f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g (l x)))
    (hcover : ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x P ≠ 0 → ∃ a, 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a))
    (hatom : ∀ a x, 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a) → f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g (lab a))) :
    ∃ (β γ : Type) (q : β → γ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), Finite β ∧ Finite γ ∧
      ∀ x, f x = ⨆ i, ⨅ j, MvPolynomial.eval x (q i j) := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype α := Fintype.ofFinite α
  letI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let δ := {ij : ι × ι // ij.1 ≠ ij.2}
  let τ := Unit ⊕ (α ⊕ δ)
  let polys : τ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ
    | .inl _ => P
    | .inr (.inl a) => p a
    | .inr (.inr ij) => g ij.val.1 - g ij.val.2
  have hn : ∀ t, polys t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t
    rcases t with t | a | ij
    · exact hP
    · exact hp a
    · exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => ij.property (hg h))
  obtain ⟨R, u, e, hsq, hu, hfac⟩ := finite_polynomial_factorization polys hn
  let ρ := {r // r ∈ R}
  let r : ρ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ := Subtype.val
  let ua (a : α) := u (.inr (.inl a))
  let ea (a : α) (k : ρ) := e (.inr (.inl a)) k.val
  let Q := ∏ k : ρ, r k
  let S : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {x | ∀ k, MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) ≠ 0}
  have hQ : Q = ∏ k ∈ R, k := Finset.prod_coe_sort R id
  have hSQ : Squarefree Q := hQ ▸ hsq
  have hnonzero (t : τ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ S) :
      MvPolynomial.eval x (polys t) ≠ 0 :=
    factorized_eval_ne_zero R (hu t) (hfac t) (fun k hk => hx ⟨k, hk⟩)
  have hcover' (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ S) : ∃ a, 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a) :=
    hcover x (hnonzero (.inl ()) x hx)
  have hlab (a : α) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ S)
      (ha : 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a)) : lab a = l x := by
    by_contra hne
    have h := hnonzero (.inr (.inr ⟨(lab a, l x), hne⟩)) x hx
    apply h
    change MvPolynomial.eval x (g (lab a) - g (l x)) = 0
    rw [map_sub, ← hatom a x ha, ← hselect x, sub_self]
  let D (k : ρ) (i j : ι) := r k ∣ g i - g j
  have hD (k : ρ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (_ : MvPolynomial.eval x (r k) = 0)
      (ho : ∀ j, j ≠ k → MvPolynomial.eval x (r j) ≠ 0)
      (i j : ι) (hij : MvPolynomial.eval x (g i) = MvPolynomial.eval x (g j)) : D k i j := by
    by_cases heq : i = j
    · simp [D, heq]
    let t : τ := .inr (.inr ⟨(i, j), heq⟩)
    apply factorized_dvd_of_eval_zero R k.property (hu t) (hfac t)
    · intro q hq hqk
      exact ho ⟨q, hq⟩ (fun h => hqk (congrArg Subtype.val h))
    · change MvPolynomial.eval x (g i - g j) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hij, sub_self]
  have hfactora (a : α) : p a = ua a * ∏ k : ρ, r k ^ ea a k := by
    change p a = u (.inr (.inl a)) * ∏ k : {r // r ∈ R}, k.val ^ e (.inr (.inl a)) k.val
    rw [Finset.prod_coe_sort R (fun k => k ^ e (.inr (.inl a)) k)]
    exact hfac (.inr (.inl a))
  have hinv (C : Set ι) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ S) (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : y ∈ S) :
      colorSign C (l x) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval x (boundaryProduct ea lab D C r)) =
      colorSign C (l y) * SignType.sign (MvPolynomial.eval y (boundaryProduct ea lab D C r)) :=
    atomic_global_invariant p ua r ea lab g D C f l hf hselect
      (fun a => hu (.inr (.inl a))) hfactora hSQ hcover' hlab hD x hx y hy
  have hreach (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ S) (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : y ∈ S) :
      (factorGraph g r x y).Reachable (l x) (l y) :=
    reachable_of_atomic_invariant g r ea lab l x y hx hy (fun C => hinv C x hx y hy)
  obtain ⟨β, q, hβ, hsep⟩ := finite_factor_separators g r f l S
    (fun x _ => hselect x) hreach
  letI : Finite β := hβ
  have hSd : Dense S := by
    have h := mvPolynomial_nonzero_dense hSQ.ne_zero
    simpa only [Q, map_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_implies, S] using h
  apply finite_polynomial_separators q f
  apply finite_separators_of_dense (fun b x => MvPolynomial.eval x (q b)) f
    (fun b => MvPolynomial.continuous_eval (q b)) hf (hSd.prod hSd)
  intro z hz
  exact hsep z.1 hz.1 z.2 hz.2


lemma atomic_cover_representation {n : ℕ} {α ι : Type} [Finite α] [Finite ι]
    (p : α → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (g : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (lab : α → ι) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hselect : ∀ x, ∃ i, f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g i))
    (hcover : ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x P ≠ 0 → ∃ a, 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a))
    (hatom : ∀ a x, 0 < MvPolynomial.eval x (p a) → f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g (lab a))) :
    ∃ (β γ : Type) (q : β → γ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), Finite β ∧ Finite γ ∧
      ∀ x, f x = ⨆ i, ⨅ j, MvPolynomial.eval x (q i j) := by
  classical
  let α' := {a : α // p a ≠ 0}
  let ι' := {q // q ∈ Set.range g}
  letI : Finite ι' := (Set.finite_range g).to_subtype
  let g' : ι' → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ := Subtype.val
  let p' (a : α') := p a.val
  let lab' (a : α') : ι' := ⟨g (lab a.val), ⟨lab a.val, rfl⟩⟩
  choose l hl using hselect
  let l' (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ι' := ⟨g (l x), ⟨l x, rfl⟩⟩
  apply atomic_selection_representation p' g' lab' P (fun a => a.property)
    Subtype.val_injective hP f l' hf hl
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcover x hx
    have hpa : p a ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      rw [heq, map_zero] at ha
      exact lt_irrefl _ ha
    exact ⟨⟨a, hpa⟩, ha⟩
  · intro a x ha
    exact hatom a.val x ha

end PierceBirkhoff

namespace PierceBirkhoff

lemma piecewise_continuous {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hf : IsPiecewiseMvPolynomial f) : Continuous f := by
  obtain ⟨ι, P, g, hι, hclosed, _, hcover, hpieces⟩ := hf
  letI : Finite ι := hι
  apply LocallyFinite.continuous (locallyFinite_of_finite P) hcover hclosed
  intro i
  exact (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval (g i)).continuousOn.congr (fun x hx => hpieces i x hx)

lemma polynomial_representation {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∃ (ι κ : Type) (g : ι → κ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), Finite ι ∧ Finite κ ∧
      ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval x p = ⨆ i, ⨅ j, MvPolynomial.eval x (g i j) := by
  refine ⟨Unit, Unit, fun _ _ => p, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  simp

/--
The Pierce-Birkhoff conjecture states that for every real piecewise-polynomial function
`f : ℝⁿ → ℝ`, there exists a finite set of polynomials `gᵢⱼ ∈ ℝ[x₁, ..., xₙ]` such that
`f = supᵢ infⱼ(gᵢⱼ)`.
-/
theorem pierce_birkhoff_conjecture {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsPiecewiseMvPolynomial f) :
    ∃ (ι κ : Type) (g : ι → κ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), Finite ι ∧ Finite κ ∧
      ∀ x, f x = ⨆ i, ⨅ j, MvPolynomial.eval x (g i j) := by
  classical
  have hcont : Continuous f := piecewise_continuous hf
  obtain ⟨ι, A, g, hι, _, hsa, hcov, hpieces⟩ := hf
  letI : Finite ι := hι
  choose ι₀ ι₁ p₀ p₁ h₀ h₁ hA using hsa
  letI : ∀ i, Finite (ι₀ i) := h₀
  letI : ∀ i, Finite (ι₁ i) := h₁
  have hchoose (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ∃ i, x ∈ A i := by
    have hx : x ∈ ⋃ i, A i := by rw [hcov]; trivial
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  by_cases hzero : ∃ i j, p₀ i j = 0
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := hzero
    have hglobal (x : Fin n → ℝ) : f x = MvPolynomial.eval x (g i) := by
      apply hpieces i x
      rw [hA i]
      apply Or.inl
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, by simp [hij]⟩
    obtain ⟨β, γ, q, hβ, hγ, hq⟩ := polynomial_representation (g i)
    exact ⟨β, γ, q, hβ, hγ, fun x => (hglobal x).trans (hq x)⟩
  · have hn (i : ι) (j : ι₀ i) : p₀ i j ≠ 0 := fun h => hzero ⟨i, j, h⟩
    let ζ := (i : ι) × ι₀ i
    let α := (i : ι) × ι₁ i
    letI : Fintype ζ := Fintype.ofFinite ζ
    let P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ := ∏ a : ζ, p₀ a.1 a.2
    have hP : P ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun a _ => hn a.1 a.2)
    apply atomic_cover_representation (fun a : α => p₁ a.1 a.2) g Sigma.fst P hP f hcont
    · intro x
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hchoose x
      exact ⟨i, hpieces i x hi⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hn' : ∀ a : ζ, MvPolynomial.eval x (p₀ a.1 a.2) ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [P, map_prod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_implies] using hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hchoose x
      rw [hA i] at hi
      rcases hi with hi | hi
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
        exact False.elim (hn' ⟨i, j⟩ hj)
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
        exact ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hj⟩
    · intro a x ha
      apply hpieces a.1 x
      rw [hA a.1]
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a.2, ha⟩)

end PierceBirkhoff
```

title: Likely misformalization in `Wikipedia/PierceBirkhoff.lean`

body:
An AI agent produced a Lean proof of the negation of `Bloch.blochConstant_exact_value` for
about **$2.37** of API spend, which is unrealistically low for a research-open conjecture from
the Wikipedia set.

AI review of the accepted proof suggests the statement is misformalized, in the following way (AI-written):

> The defect is in the schlicht-disk clause shared by `blochRadius`, `blochConstant`, and
> `univalentBlochConstant`:
>
> ```lean
> noncomputable def blochConstant : ℝ :=
>   sSup {B : ℝ | ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball 0 1) → deriv f 0 = 1 →
>     ∃ S ⊆ ball 0 1, ∃ x, ball x B ⊆ f '' S ∧ InjOn f S}
> ```
>
> Here `S` is an **arbitrary subset** of the disk (no openness or connectedness is required), so
> the injectivity requirement `InjOn f S` is vacuous: for any disk `ball x B ⊆ f '' (ball 0 1)`,
> a set-theoretic section of `f` (one preimage per point, via choice) is a set `S` with
> `f '' S = ball x B` and `InjOn f S`. The condition is therefore equivalent to
> `∃ x, ball x B ⊆ f '' (ball 0 1)`, i.e. `blochConstant` as defined equals the **Landau**
> constant, not the Bloch constant. A schlicht disk should be the univalent image of a
> *subdomain*: `S` open and connected (with, classically, `f '' S` equal to the disk).
>
> The formalized equality is then genuinely false: the Landau constant is known to be at least
> 1/2, which exceeds the Ahlfors–Grunsky value Γ(1/3)Γ(11/12)/(Γ(1/4)√(1+√3)) ≈ 0.4719. The
> accepted disproof works exactly through this gap; its own comments note that "the definition
> imposes no openness condition on `S`". It proceeds by (1) proving a Landau-type bound: every `f` with
> `DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball 0 1)` and `deriv f 0 = 1` has a disk of radius 49/100 in its image;
> (2) satisfying `InjOn` with a choice section; and (3) bounding the Γ-expression below 49/100
> via log-convexity of Γ. No claim about the actual Bloch constant is involved.
>
> Suggested fix: in all three definitions, require `S` to be an open connected set on which `f`
> is injective (e.g. `IsOpen S ∧ IsConnected S ∧ InjOn f S ∧ ball x B ⊆ f '' S`, or the stronger
> `f '' S = ball x B` formulation). `landauRadius`/`landauConstant` in the same file are
> unaffected.
